_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); discount-retail signals

pit_profile.why: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'everyday low prices (“EDLP”)'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its segments compete with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarkets, and 'internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2012 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it

classification.quality_note: Walmart: 'operates retail stores in various formats around the world and is committed to saving people money so they can live better'; 'everyday low prices (“EDLP”)'; 'The retail business is highly competitive' (its segments compete with discount, department, drug, variety and specialty stores, supermarkets, supercenter-type stores and hypermarkets, and 'internet-based retailers and catalog businesses'); and 'General economic conditions, globally or in one or more of the markets we serve, may adversely affect our financial performance' (its own FY2012 10-K): a low-price store network whose demand follows the consumer economy by its own account; no disruption theme is live for it. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.26x; +6% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.13; conservative 2yr +21%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.3%/yr (Q2 ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.9%/yr (FY03-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +17.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: WMT (retrospective, 2012-08-24) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.26x (15.4% downside to Bear $61 / +59.5% upside to Bull $115) | Adj composite 1.98 vs market 2.11: gap -0.13 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +6% above the EPP floor $68 (14x FY13E $4.88) | Conservative 2-yr case: +21.4% total (+10.7%/yr) | At 14.8x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $95 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. comps +2.4% in Q2 FY13, forward sales +6.5% (no FY13 net sales guide in numbers, Q2 FY13 net sales at constant currency); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
